header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: None present on behalf of the petitioners nor any intimation is received. Perusal of record reflects that the grievance of the petitioners is in respect of Fotikhatabadal, for which they have alternate remedy before District Redressal Committee, constituted by the Government of Sindh. In view of the above, this petition is disposed of alongwith listed application(s).
